briefText:
Page type: b2b product landing
Audience: enterprise software buyers
Objective: explain governed website generation and drive product evaluation
Must preserve semantic HTML.
Do not invent testimonials, metrics, customer logos, or pricing.

hero.headline: Evidence before pixels
hero.value-proposition: Compile governed sites from traceable inputs, explicit contracts and runtime proof.

features.headline: A compiler you can audit
feature-items: Every stage emits an exact artifact identity
Responsive and motion contracts execute in the browser
Unknown rights and missing evidence fail closed

proof-items: Runtime receipts bind results to an exact commit
Browser observations record the rendered output
Release profiles expose every unmet capability

briefText:
Page type: editorial feature
Audience: long-form readers
Objective: prioritize reading hierarchy and evidence-backed narrative
Must support reduced motion.
Do not invent authors, publications, metrics, or pricing.

editorial-hero.headline: The quiet machinery behind trustworthy interfaces
editorial-hero.dek: A field guide to preserving meaning while a design system moves from brief to browser.

article-body.body-content: A useful compiler does more than assemble sections. It keeps the reason for every decision close to the resulting artifact, so readers and reviewers can distinguish observed behavior from an attractive claim.

related-content.headline: Continue the investigation
related-items: How responsive contracts preserve reading order
Why incomplete evidence should remain visible
What browser receipts can and cannot prove

briefText:
Page type: premium consumer brand site
Audience: high-intent consumer buyers
Objective: present a distinctive premium product story with a clear action
Must preserve accessible commerce actions.
Do not invent customer logos, testimonials, metrics, or pricing.

brand-hero.headline: Made for a slower kind of attention
brand-hero.value-proposition: A restrained collection shaped by tactile materials, deliberate proportions and lasting utility.

product-showcase.headline: Form, repair and daily use
product-showcase.product-description: A sculptural everyday object with a quiet profile and a repairable, modular construction.

proof-items: Care and repair guidance remains available after purchase
Packaging decisions are documented by product

briefText:
Page type: motion-heavy creative site
Audience: creative technology audiences
Objective: create a paced interactive narrative without blocking the primary action
Must support reduced motion.
Never make motion required for comprehension.

creative-hero.headline: Motion with a reason
creative-hero.value-proposition: A paced narrative where movement reveals causality and the complete story remains available without animation.

story-beats: Orient with a stable opening frame
Reveal relationships as the story advances
Return control before the primary decision

interactive-showcase.interaction-purpose: Let visitors scrub between the authored states while semantic copy owns the explanation.

conversion.cta-headline: Take the idea into the studio

briefText:
Page type: interactive 2d experience
Audience: interactive product visitors
Objective: demonstrate a 2D experience while preserving semantic fallbacks
Must preserve semantic HTML.
Never require canvas for primary content.

experience-hero.headline: A canvas that explains itself
experience-hero.task: Arrange the field, compare its states and keep every conclusion available in semantic HTML.

pixi-stage.scene-purpose: Visualize a bounded field of responsive particles as optional feedback for direct manipulation.

how-it-works.headline: Direct, bounded, recoverable
feature-items: Pointer and keyboard paths describe the same task
The renderer stays inside an explicit draw-call budget
A static explanation survives every graphics failure

briefText:
Page type: interactive 3d showcase
Audience: spatial-interface visitors
Objective: demonstrate a governed 3D experience with a clear fallback path
Must support reduced motion.
Never require WebGL for primary content.

experience-hero.headline: Space without the black box
experience-hero.task: Inspect a bounded scene whose camera, geometry and fallback remain explicit.

three-stage.scene-purpose: Reveal depth and material response without moving primary content into the GPU layer.

capabilities.headline: A scene with declared limits
feature-items: Geometry and draw calls stay within a measured budget
Device loss returns to a semantic static state
WebGPU remains opt-in until hardware evidence exists

conversion.cta-headline: See how the scene is governed
